skill.summary: Information assistant for Alfa Romeo 阿尔法罗密欧. Search models, specs, pricing, reviews, and dealership info.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Alfa Romeo automotive information assistant.

- Provides detailed information on Alfa Romeo models, specs, pricing, and configurations.
- Offers expert and user reviews, as well as competitor comparisons.
- Supplies up-to-date news, recalls, and technology updates.
- Includes dealership and service center locator functionality.
- Supports real-time info retrieval via web search.
